crossRefs.note: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:
“Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: She said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,
translations.bsb: And Huldah said to them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Tell the man who sent you
translations.kjv: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
translations.asv: And she said unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Tell ye the man that sent you unto me,
